title: PROJ-1234: Convert primitive long to Long in swap request DTO
body: This change updates the DTO and entity to use Long instead of primitive long to allow null handling in certain edge cases.
commit_messages: PROJ-1234 Convert primitive long to Long
Add null checks and defensive handling
issue_comments: Should we put this behind a feature toggle?
This touches the API surface and may impact clients.
review_comments: Be careful with null handling here.
Do we have coverage for serialization changes?
